subject: Private offer: Acme Corp — rev-share & termination negotiation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Harris <lisa.harris@acme-corp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>, AWS Marketplace AE <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:23:00 +0000
Subject: Private offer submission — Acme Corp

Hi Lisa / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I'm submitting the request to publish a Private Offer for Acme Corp via AWS Marketplace to simplify procurement. Key asks from your side captured below: 

- Private Offer with upfront commitment: 12 months, $420k annualized
- Rev-share to accommodate Acme's reseller: 20% of gross marketplace revenue (to be paid to reseller)
- Early termination: 30-day termination right with pro-rated refund for unused commitment
- Requirement to mirror same commercial terms on Azure and GCP marketplaces where Acme transacts

I've attached the term sheet that Acme sent and a rev-share schedule. AWS AE, can you confirm marketplace feasibility and whether the requested reseller payout is workable from AWS's side?

Lisa — I'll loop Evelyn from Deal Desk to help coordinate approvals and legal redlines. If anything needs adjustment to align with Redwood platform policy, please call it out.

Next steps: procurement confirm final signatories and we can route for DocuSign once marketplace terms are aligned.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Sr. Account Executive, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1-415-555-0192

Attachments: Acme_PrivateOffer_TermSheet_v3.pdf (pdf), requested_revshare_schedule.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Harris <lisa.harris@acme-corp.com>, Acme Reseller <reseller@partner-distrib.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private offer submission — Acme Corp

Jordan / Evelyn —

Thanks for submitting. A couple clarifications from procurement:

1) The 20% rev-share is required to keep margin for our reseller partner. Acme will only route marketplace transactions through reseller if the revenue pass-through is available.

2) The 30-day early termination clause is important to our finance team because of cashflow seasonality; we'd prefer to keep it at 30 days with pro-rated refund.

3) We will need the private offer to explicitly allow execution across AWS, Azure, and GCP with materially equivalent terms — we typically ask for a single commercial negotiation that can be mirrored in each marketplace (same % rev-share and termination mechanics).

If Redwood cannot accept the 20% rev-share, please indicate the maximum you can offer and any alternative routing (e.g., reseller rebate outside marketplace).

Regards,
Procurement Team
Acme Corp
procurement@acme-corp.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Private offer submission — Acme Corp (deal desk intake)

Vivek —

Looping you in for visibility and exec signoff guidance. Acme is requesting a marketplace private offer with two non-standard asks: 1) a 20% rev-share to pay their reseller; 2) a 30-day early termination right with pro-rated refund. They also require the same commercial terms across AWS/Azure/GCP.

Deal context: ARR $420k (12 month), expected first invoice in Q4. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567.

Impact considerations:
- 20% marketplace rev-share materially reduces net unit economics; currently our standard marketplace rev-share ceiling is 15% for private offers given cost assumptions.
- Early termination at 30 days increases churn risk for committed capacity; we typically allow 90-day termination for private offers tied to reserved capacity.

Jordan has asked for a direct exec signoff if we can approve an exception to these caps. Legal wants parity across marketplaces (i.e., whatever we approve for AWS must be matched for Azure/GCP) to avoid mixed obligations.

Request: Vivek, can you authorize an exception for this account, and if so, please confirm the maximum approved marketplace rev-share and termination window we can commit to. If you prefer, we can propose a compromise (e.g., 18% rev-share, 90-day termination, and one-time reseller rebate for the first invoice).

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

Attachment: requested_revshare_schedule.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal_ops@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FW: Private offer submission — Acme Corp (deal desk intake)

Thanks for flagging, Evelyn. I reviewed the deal economics and the attached revenue model. A few points: 

- We prioritize enterprise adoption, particularly where marketplace presence simplifies procurement. I'm open to making a commercial concession, but need to protect unit economics and precedent.

- Proposed approval for exec signoff: up to 18% marketplace rev-share for AWS/Azure/GCP (must be identical across all three marketplaces), and a 90-day termination window for private offers tied to reserved capacity. For one-time customer accommodation, we can offer a single up-front reseller rebate (not ongoing rev-share) equivalent to 2% for the first invoice to cover reseller onboarding costs.

- Conditions: Legal must confirm our standard data protections and SLA language remain intact, and procurement must accept Redwood's standard refund proration methodology (90 days pro-rata), documented in the term sheet. If procurement insists on 30 days, we will not approve.

Jordan — please convey the conditional approval to Acme and ask them to confirm acceptance of these conditions. If they push back, escalate back to me with their counter. Legal Ops, please draft the revised term sheet and prepare a DocuSign envelope (JIRA SUP-4321).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
+1-650-555-0147

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Harris <lisa.harris@acme-corp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace AE <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private offer submission — Acme Corp — Redwood conditional approval

Hi Lisa / Procurement team —

Thanks for your patience. Redwood can approve a private offer on the following conditional basis: 

- Marketplace rev-share: 18% (applies to AWS, Azure, and GCP equally)
- Early termination: 90-day notice for private offers tied to reserved capacity; refunds pro-rated per standard Redwood methodology
- One-time reseller onboarding rebate: 2% credit on the first invoice (not ongoing rev-share)
- Legal & security: Redwood's standard data protections, SLA, and audit provisions must remain unchanged

If these conditions are acceptable, we'll route a revised term sheet and a DocuSign envelope for signature. Legal Ops will include the redlined term sheet and update the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567.

Please confirm by EOD Monday and indicate the signatory for the DocuSign packet. If you need the 30-day termination window, we'll need to escalate for an exception and that may delay execution.

Best,
Jordan
